;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**The separatist [[Southern Transitional Council]] (STC) announces the establishment of a self-rule administration in southern [[Yemen]]. The internationally-recognized government describes this move as "catastrophic." STC forces are deployed in the city of [[Aden]] as emergency rule is declared. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-yemen-security-south/stc-announces-plan-for-self-rule-in-south-yemen-government-calls-move-catastrophic-idUKKCN228001?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*The [[Lost Apple Project]], a non-profit conservationist society based in the [[Pacific Northwest]], announces the rediscovery of ten cultivars of [[apple]]s previously thought to be extinct. The decad <!-- do not replace with "decade", this is not a spelling error -->almost doubles the total amount of species the society has rescued, bringing the total to 23. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/25/us/extinct-apples-discovered-in-pacific-scn-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] confirms the [[United Kingdom|UK's]] death toll from COVID-19 has exceeded 20,000. It joins the [[United States]], [[Italy]], [[Spain]] and [[France]] as the fifth nation to reach this total. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52424413 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[Bangladesh–Myanmar relations]]
**Foreign Minister of [[Bangladesh]] [[AK Abdul Momen]] says that it is not the responsibility of his country to rescue more than 500 [[Rohingya]] refugees who have been at sea for weeks. Momen tells ''[[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]]'' they "should ask the [[Myanmar government]] first because they are their citizens". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/rohingya-stranded-sea-bangladesh-responsibility-200425082607464.html (Al Jazeera)]
